verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes a dedicated O-1A eligibility checker on its own site. The founder answers a few questions and receives a personalized assessment, which delivers the core of a self-serve structured qualifier. Missing for 10: explicit statement that the check is free, a dedicated EB-1A self-serve checker (EB-1A eligibility assessment appears only as part of the paid case service), detail on the questions or scoring structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site

citations.quote: Find out in 2 minutes if you qualify for the "extraordinary ability" visa. Answer a few questions and get a personalized assessment from immigration attorneys.
